Permits & License Committee  July 24, 2025
Minutes  Page 1 of 3

  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  July 24, 2025

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted as a Call-In at 1+ (669) 900-6833;
meeting ID 982 4253 6876 and Password 828281 on July 24, 2025 at 2:03 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh , Administration Department
  Christine Rivera, Planning Department.
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, LA County Fire Department
  Victoria Ojeda, Public Works Department
  Emory Ward, Emergency Services/ Public Safety Department

  Staff Present:  Aisha L. Thompson , City Clerk’s Department
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Harjinder Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Harjinder Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the special meeting held on July 17, 2025

Permit(s):

Item #1:  Liore Dygola on behalf of City of Limitless Creative Company, LLC to host a WSS Back To
  School with Vans and Nike Event at 3000 W Century Blvd; at Private Property; on Saturday,
  August 2, 2025 from 12:00 p.m. – 4:00 p.m; Sunday, August 3, 2025 from 12:00 p.m. -4:00
  p.m. August 16, 2025, from 12:00 p.m. -4:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY Approval
  for a (3) time event within WSS parking lot; Approved; Applicant to hire 2 police officers for
  public safety and a min. 7 professional - licensed security guards to assist IPD with any
  potential crowd control. Applicant shall have water barriers or protective barriers in the
  parking lot where pedestrians will be present (layer of protection to pedestrians).No additional
  requirements for Fire approval.; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned
  immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall
  follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety
  guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and
  Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and
  regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activty No.
  00406184)
 Permits & License Committee  July 24, 2025
Minutes  Page 2 of 3

Item #2:  Anthony Harris on behalf of City of Inglewood to host a Swim Up Inglewood Movie Screening
  Event at 700 Warren Ln; Edward Vincent Jr Park – grassy area east of the swimming pool
  complex; Public Property; on Friday, August 8, 2025 from 7:00 p.m. – 9:00 p.m. APPROVED
  CONDITIONALLY Approval for one (1) day event at Edward Vincent Park; There will be IPD
  personnel staffed at this event, Park staff to be present to maintain restrooms that attendees
  / guests will be utilizing, IPD officers assigned should be checking the restrooms to deter any
  outside lewd conduct activity;None Fire recommendations; Maintain site at all times, ensuring
  site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members
  working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face
  mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State
  health department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried
  unanimously ( Activity NO 00406110)

Item #3:  Mira Gerges on behalf of Holy Annunciation Coptic Church to host a Holy Annunciation’s
  Annual Fundraiser Event at 2225 W Manchester Blvd; Private property; on Friday, August
  22, 2025 from 9 :00 a.m. - 8:00 p.m.,Saturday, August 23, 2025 from 9:00 a.m. -8:00 p.m.;
  Sunday, August 24, 2025 from 9:00 a.m. – 6:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY
  Approval for a three (3) day event within Holy Annunciation Church parking lot. Applicant to
  hire eight (8) License Professional Security Guards; No Police Contigent if there’s no incident
  at the event , if there’s an incendent, next time the applicant wil be required to add IPD to
  there future events. None Code Enforcement conditions None Fire recommendations;
  Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the
  event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing,
  protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO.
  Health Department and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA
  County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and
  signage. Motion carried unanimously ( Activity NO 00406147)
